_doc: Declarative world spec for cw01-e03 (sparse computational coalitions). Written during PREFLIGHT, before implementation. Activation is PRICED; nothing rewards sparsity, specialisation or teaming. The STATIC solution (ignore the input, always fire the same subset) is deliberately inside the search space, so 'sparse but blind' is reachable and is the honest null outcome.

affordances._note: Per affordance, per item. Activating everything is always POSSIBLE and always expensive. Nothing forbids it. Affordances carry no metadata about what they are good at.

items._needs: Each latent class requires a specific subset of 3 of the 16 affordances. Subsets may overlap between classes, so the partition is not trivially separable.
items._observable: Items carry an observable feature vector drawn from a class-dependent distribution WITH OVERLAP. The class itself is LATENT and never readable. Conditional routing is therefore possible but must be inferred, not looked up.

info_model.coverage: fraction of the item's 3 needs met by activated affordances
info_model._note: Activating an affordance the item does not need costs full price and yields nothing. Redundant activation is pure waste, but is never forbidden.

genome._shape: per affordance a: bias b_a plus a weight vector w_a over the 4 observable features. Activation when sigmoid(b_a + w_a . x) exceeds 0.5. 16 x 5 = 80 real parameters, plus 2 neutral genes.
genome._neutral: No phenotype by construction; they are the cost-matched sham for knockout interventions and the drift floor for any ordering claim (CW01-D027). Verified inert by Q6.
genome._static_is_reachable: Setting all w_a to 0 yields a fixed activation set regardless of input. That is the NULL outcome and it must remain reachable; engineering it away would rig the experiment.

arms._critical: Arms differ ONLY in affordances. The item stream is drawn from a stream_seed that never sees the arm, and ALL policy draws are hoisted and drawn unconditionally (CW01-D019/D021). Q10 asserts bit-identical metrics when the mechanism is disabled.

control_no_conditionality._tests: weights forced to zero: the organism may be sparse but cannot be conditional

control_activate_all._tests: full coverage at maximum cost; the expensive baseline

measurements.primary: delta(useful_information_transformed / resource_cost) vs ancestor, matched world+budget
measurements.sparsity: mean fraction of the 16 affordances activated per item
measurements.conditionality: mutual information I(latent_class ; activation_pattern), in bits
measurements.routing_precision: fraction of activations that were actually needed by the item
measurements._separation: Sparsity and conditionality are reported as TWO INDEPENDENT quantities. Low sparsity with zero conditionality is cheapness without coalition, and is a NEGATIVE for the coalition claim however elegant it looks.

I1_scramble_structure.effect: permute which affordance is useful for which class; all costs identical
I1_scramble_structure.sham: identity permutation at the same cost
I1_scramble_structure._decisive: a coalition matched to real structure must collapse; static sparsity should not care

I2_force_all.effect: every affordance fires on every item, costs paid
I2_force_all.sham: force-activate the same NUMBER the organism would have chosen

I3_knockout._note: the random control is what makes this informative; named so it cannot be dropped

I4_transplant.effect: move an evolved population to a world with different hidden structure, identical costs

qualify_predicates._rule: ALL must pass before science budget is spent. Most are STANDING GATES promoted from e01/e02 failures.
qualify_predicates.Q2_activation_is_a_real_trade: measured: cost(activate all 16) materially exceeds cost(activate the 3 needed), and full coverage is worth more than partial
qualify_predicates.Q3_shams_are_cost_matched: I1's sham applies the identity permutation at identical cost; permuting structure costs no resources
qualify_predicates.Q5_durable_without_redis: at least one row written and interpretable with the redis import blocked
qualify_predicates.Q7_pressure_actually_binds: activate-all is measurably worse than selective activation; the budget makes the choice matter
qualify_predicates.Q8_not_a_free_lunch: REACHABILITY PROBE: hand-built ROUTER must beat hand-built STATIC-SPARSE and ACTIVATE-ALL, and a badly-configured router must LOSE. Probe genomes asserted pairwise DISTINCT (CW01-D023).
qualify_predicates.Q9_mechanism_fires: in the hand-built best case, conditionality (MI) is materially above zero and routing_precision is high
qualify_predicates.Q10_matched_arms: with conditionality disabled, treatment and control_no_conditionality produce BIT-IDENTICAL metrics from the same stream seed
qualify_predicates.Q11_MI_calibrated_against_shuffled_null: STANDING GATE, e03-specific: mutual information is biased UPWARD on small samples. Compute MI on shuffled class labels; the real MI must exceed the shuffled null's 99th percentile. A detector that reports conditionality on noise will manufacture coalitions exactly as e02's gain detector manufactured ratchets (CW01-D022).
qualify_predicates.Q12_disposition_rule_is_executable: disposition computed by lib/lineage.decide from PREREGISTRATION.md, including replication; a branch is UNREACHABLE unless its tests ran (CW01-D024)
qualify_predicates.Q13_latent_class_is_not_free: the class label must be unreadable by the organism; only the overlapping feature vector is observable. If class were free, routing would be trivial and the result meaningless.

backend_counterfactual.requirement_IX: organism-visible physics reproducible on a second backend
backend_counterfactual.equivalence_test: same seeds + same arm on both backends must produce identical per-organism metric vectors
backend_counterfactual.cap_rule: if not exercised within timebox, disposition is capped at INCONCLUSIVE and may NOT be COMPLETE
